flashcard_questions.q: Who was the real Diane Nash?
flashcard_questions.a: A student activist at Fisk University, Nashville.

flashcard_questions.q: What did Diane Nash organise after the first riders were attacked?
flashcard_questions.a: A second wave of Freedom Riders.

flashcard_questions.q: Which character asks “Who the hell is Diane Nash?”
Why did Diane Nash stand at a higher level in the flashback?
flashcard_questions.a: To show she was in control and held authority.

flashcard_questions.q: How did the students show they were listening to Diane Nash?
flashcard_questions.a: They sat in a circle, knees to chests, straining to see her.

flashcard_questions.q: How did Diane Nash’s physicality show she would not be moved?
flashcard_questions.a: She stayed rooted, with a straight tall back and hands held in front.

flashcard_questions.q: What gesture did Dayz use on “me” in “You elected me as your leader”?
flashcard_questions.a: She placed her palm across her chest in a patriotic fashion.

flashcard_questions.q: How did Diane Nash deliver “I do not shrink from it”?
flashcard_questions.a: In a staccato rhythm with clear pauses between words.

flashcard_questions.q: Which line shows the Freedom Riders knew they might die?
flashcard_questions.a: “We signed our wills, we know someone will get killed.”

flashcard_questions.q: How did CJ and Em direct attention during the phone call?
flashcard_questions.a: They turned their heads from side to side, like watching tennis.

flashcard_questions.q: Which sound signalled a move to Bobby Kennedy’s office?
flashcard_questions.a: A snapshot of the American national anthem.

flashcard_questions.q: What formation did the actors take to open the CJ Reminder scene?
Why was Ty, as Jim, placed at the highest level?
flashcard_questions.a: It reflected the power status of White people in 1960s society.

flashcard_questions.q: What did CJ’s step forward show the audience?
flashcard_questions.a: That today’s society believes everyone should be treated equally.

flashcard_questions.q: What did CJ’s slump at the end of the scene show?
flashcard_questions.a: The ordeal had taken a physical and emotional toll.
